welcome.headline: Live chickens delivered to your door.
welcome.subhead: Shisanyamas, kota shops, taverns and caterers order live chickens from us. We buy from approved suppliers and deliver. Suppliers and drivers can sign up too.
welcome.step1.title: 1. Order
welcome.step1.body: Choose the bird type and how many you need, then drop a pin for the delivery address. You see the price straight away.
welcome.step2.title: 2. We arrange it
welcome.step2.body: We pick an approved supplier near you and book a driver. You don’t deal with either of them.
welcome.step3.title: 3. Delivered
welcome.step3.body: The driver brings your chickens on the day we confirm. Count them together, then give the driver your delivery code.
